detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #12 Lone Wolf DNS Bridge A browser proxy setting does not cover every DNS client. Lone Wolf gives local applications a DNS bridge on port 53 and forwards resolution through Tor DNSPort 5353. Its supervisor checks the bridge listeners, Tor's DNS, transparent TCP and SOCKS listeners, and bootstrap completion. Readiness is refreshed while those checks pass. A required check failing after startup clears readiness and ends the supervisor. The dedicated firewall blocks direct external DNS, keeping the resolver path aligned with the mode's routing policy. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
